_note: Annualization assumptions. Bars per year = tradingDays x ceil(sessionHours*3600 / intervalSeconds) for intraday; daily = tradingDays; weekly = 52; monthly = 12. Stocks/ETFs/indices/futures: 252 days x 6.5h regular session (partial last bar counted, e.g. 1h = 7 bars/day). FX: 252 days x 24h. Crypto: 365 days x 24h.
